title: CollectionInput
description: Write model of a collection release record (Ingest API `PUT /collections/{external_id}`, admin catalog). A product whose `collection` names no record is not held.

brand_external_id.description: MAY be omitted when the node has exactly one brand.

name.description: The `collection` value of its products. Unique per brand among records (409 `conflict`).

state.description: held: the collection's products, their variants and assets are not visible to any retailer. released: visible. Omitted on create: `held` when `release_at` is in the future, else `released`; omitted on replace: kept.

release_at.description: Scheduled release. While `state` is `held` and this moment has passed, the node releases the collection (state becomes `released`, `released_at` = this value). null = no schedule.

released_at.description: Read-only (Ingest GET): when the collection last became visible, null while it never was. Ignored on write.
